retrievalProfile.description: A warm-toned portrait layout featuring a musician in the foreground with a grand piano in the background, utilizing a mix of lowercase and uppercase serif typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A medium close-up portrait of a male artist leaning against a textured pillar, set against a sun-drenched outdoor background featuring a grand piano. The color palette is dominated by warm ochre, deep burgundy, and soft shadows, with typography placed in the lower right quadrant.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject in foreground left, instrument in background right
Warm sunlight creating long, diagonal shadows
Textured suede clothing contrasting with smooth piano surfaces
Typography anchored to the bottom right corner
coreInvariants: Presence of a grand piano as a thematic anchor
Mixed-case serif typography for the artist name

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Male subject occupies the left two-thirds of the frame, shown from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The artist's face and the grand piano in the background create a diagonal balance.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the artist's face, down the line of the jacket to the typography, then back to the piano in the background.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open sunlit ground between the subject and the piano provides breathing room for the composition.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm ochre and tan (background and lighting)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the reds and yellows with soft, diffused value transitions in the shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Classical serif with high stroke contrast

composition.relationshipToImage: Overlaid on the subject's jacket and background

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between lowercase and uppercase of the same or similar serif family.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and sharp serifs of the display text.
Provides the elegant, modern serif look required for the artist name.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a warm, sunlit outdoor portrait of a man in a burgundy suede jacket leaning against a stone pillar, with a grand piano visible in the soft-focus background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the artist's name in the bottom right corner using a high-contrast serif font, with the first name in lowercase white and the last name in uppercase black.
